message: The spouse-viewer test can pass on the pre-GetUser render, because 'View Yourself' is also the label shown while the viewer is unknown.
dismissalDetail: telling which person the viewer is needs an API field, MPDX-10399 adds it with the submitted view and replaces the staff group guess

message: A spouse who is also joining staff has a NewStaff base group, so they are read as the questionnaire's staff member and see their own photo on the staff member's card plus reversed toggle labels.
dismissalDetail: same viewer identity gap, an API field naming the viewer lands in MPDX-10399

message: otherIsViewer now depends on viewerIsStaffMember, which is false until GetUser loads, so a new-staff viewer with a blank spouse name briefly sees 'View Yourself' (and keeps it if GetUser fails).
dismissalDetail: same viewer identity gap, an API field naming the viewer lands in MPDX-10399

message: toggleName uses ?? so an empty-string first name skips the Yourself/Spouse fallback and the button reads 'View '.
dismissalDetail: a blank first name is already sent as null by the API, revisit with the viewer identity change in MPDX-10399

message: The GlobalStaff test asserts right after the first update, and result.current is true during loading anyway, so it may not catch a regression that removes the canSeeHrTools skip.
dismissalDetail: tighten with the hook changes in MPDX-10399, the regression check by hand fails this test today

message: No test checks that the switch's accessible name updates after toggling, which is the behavior the change is for.
dismissalDetail: fold into MPDX-10399, which edits these tests

message: The switch's accessible name now changes with its state ('...: Closed' to '...: Open'), so screen readers can announce a name that contradicts the on/off state.
dismissalDetail: the name keeps the visible Open or Closed word so voice control can target it, and the switch still reports on or off

message: The test named for international and stint staff only runs NewInternationalStaff, and the staff-member side of otherIsViewer with a blank spouse name is untested.
dismissalDetail: same viewer identity gap, an API field naming the viewer lands in MPDX-10399

message: A spouse viewer never sees their own avatar on their own card, even though userData.user.avatar is their photo.
dismissalDetail: same viewer identity gap, an API field naming the viewer lands in MPDX-10399

message: A second local canSeeHrTools with a different meaning (no developer bypass) now sits next to useNavPages' canSeeHrTools, so the gate can drift.
dismissalDetail: this guards the data query, not the tab, and developers see every tool without it

message: A GetUser failure now hides the questionnaire menu item, since userType is undefined and canSeeHrTools is false, which cuts against the hook's own rule at line 26.
dismissalDetail: with no user loaded the HR Tools tab itself is hidden, so hiding the item matches

message: The key 'NSO MPD Questionnaire: {{status}}' splices in a separately translated Open/Closed word, which can read awkwardly in gendered locales.
dismissalDetail: same pattern as the other HR Tools status labels, translators see the placeholder

message: userPending in skip is redundant, since userType is undefined whenever user data is absent and !canSeeHrTools already skips.
dismissalDetail: keeps the skip explicit while GetUser loads
